Each # Errors block lists: (1) caller-precondition InvalidArgument cases (empty since_state, empty ids, empty creation-id keys, etc.), (2) InvalidSession from missing primary account for the relevant capability URI, (3) any serde_json::to_value InvalidArgument case for /set update maps (with 3-4× memory-peak discussion citing reqwest's buffering behavior — the corrected wording from JMAP-wzq9.35), (4) transport variants returned by JmapClient::call (Http/Parse/AuthFailed/MethodError/MethodNotFound/ResponseTooLarge/UnexpectedResponse), (5) method-level errors specific to /query (anchorNotFound, unsupportedFilter, unsupportedSort), /queryChanges (cannotCalculateChanges), /copy (fromAccountNotFound, fromAccountNotSupportedByMethod). description:
Canonical mail-client analog of JMAP-wzq9.31 (metadata-client).

`grep -n "# Errors" crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/*.rs` returns ZERO hits.
All `email_*`, `mailbox_*`, `thread_*`, `identity_*`, `submission_*`, `search_snippet_*`, `vacation_*` method builders return `Result<_, jmap_base_client::ClientError>` without a `# Errors` rustdoc section.

## What goes wrong

1. Undocumented client-side validation paths. e.g. `email_changes` (crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs:75-79) and `thread_changes` etc. include defence-in-depth empty-state guards that return `Err(ClientError::InvalidArgument)` with a method-specific message. A caller reading the doc-comment has no way to discover this — they would reasonably assume an empty `&State` round-trips to the server.

2. Rustdoc convention + clippy::missing_errors_doc. The standard rustdoc convention is that public `fn` returning `Result` documents each variant in a `# Errors` section.

## Concrete error variants each method should document

- All methods: `ClientError::InvalidSession` when `self.session` has no primary account for the relevant capability (via `session_parts`)
- All methods: `ClientError::HttpError` / `ParseError` / `ApiError` from `call_internal` → upstream `JmapClient::call`
- `*_changes` / `*_query_changes` methods: additionally `ClientError::InvalidArgument` when `since_state` / `since_query_state` is empty (defence-in-depth guard)
- `*_set` methods: `ClientError::InvalidArgument` for serialize failures on the update map (see metadata-client's existing `# Errors` section on `metadata_set` for the established style — but note JMAP-wzq9.35 has filed against the factual error about "streamed" in that exact doc-comment)

## Workspace propagation

Per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates", this is the canonical sweep. Fix here first, then propagate to all 7 extension-client siblings (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata). The metadata-client side is tracked at JMAP-wzq9.31.

## Cross-refs

- JMAP-wzq9.31 — metadata-client side of this finding
- JMAP-wzq9.35 — separate finding about a factual error in the one existing # Errors section on metadata_set
title: mail-client methods: missing # Errors rustdoc sections family-wide
